claims.text: Many reviewers praise the included oils, describing them as wonderful and enjoyable, though some dislike the scents or doubt their quality.
A common complaint is that the diffuser produces weak or barely noticeable mist and smell, with several saying it hardly works.
Reviewers frequently mention difficulty removing or opening the top/lid, and some report refilling is a struggle.
Several reviewers report the unit breaking or failing, including quitting after two days and buttons getting stuck.
Some reviewers are pleased with the product overall, citing easy use, strong aroma, calming light, and good size.
